svg.title: A short film. Day 19: nineteen pieces of work each say finished. Back on day 1, an AI agent changed one setting; nothing says which of the nineteen stood on it, so none can be relied on without checking again. The same day with ThesisAnalysisOS: the result reads stale and names model/settings.json before anything is built on it. Something changed. What still holds? Each result answers holds, stale, fails or unknown.
svg.text: BACK ON DAY 1, WITHOUT A RECORD
Every piece of work says finished.
An AI agent changed one setting.
That same day, the result reads stale.
Day 1. Nothing has been built on it yet.
The next result will stand on all of them.
you can still be sure of
Which ones stood on that setting? Nothing says.

g.text: Every result is kept with the files its check reads. Ask later, and it says which results still hold.
